title: VRC Relationship Issue — payload
description: Delivers one party's signed Verifiable Relationship Credential to the other within an accepted relationship exchange. Performed once in each direction; the response is a delivery receipt that does not echo the credential back.

vrc.description: A signed W3C Verifiable Relationship Credential (opaque here). Its issuer MUST be the issuing party's relationship DID and its credential subject MUST name the receiving party's relationship DID — the values the accepted proposal exchanged.

vrcDigestMultibase.description: Multibase-encoded multihash over the credential — the registry's converged digest form — so the delivery can be tied to later references to the credential without re-hashing.

Response.title: VRC Relationship Issue — response payload
Response.description: The delivery receipt: the receiving party accepted and stored the credential. A refusal is a trust-task-error, never a receipt with received: false.

received.description: Always true: a refusal travels as a trust-task-error. Present so acceptance is explicit rather than inferred from the response's existence.

vrcDigestMultibase.description: Echo of the delivered credential's digest, computed by the receiver, so a mismatch between what was sent and what was stored is detectable in-band.
